sources.title: Snakemake rules and resources
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: FireWorks：動態 detour、停止界與科研血緣
related.titleEn: FireWorks: dynamic detours, stopping bounds and scientific lineage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：輸出與排程皆合格才接受時間改善。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Accept timing improvement only when artifacts and schedule both satisfy their contracts.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「FireWorks：動態 detour、停止界與科研血緣」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付兩組缺陷歷程、動態 DAG、停止狀態表與血緣 manifest。
related.differenceEn: Investigate FireWorks: dynamic detours, stopping bounds and scientific lineage using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver defect histories, a dynamic DAG, termination-state tables and a lineage manifest showing which adaptive result authorizes each subsequent task and final aggregation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 時間零啟動 A、B；四秒啟動 C，六秒啟動 D，十一秒啟動 E，逐段計槽數。
列 1、1/2、1/4、1/8、1/16，標初值與四次更新；相等邊界明訂接受。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Start A and B at zero, C at four, D at six and E at eleven. Check slot occupancy across each interval and identify B-D-E as the limiting dependency chain.

List one, one half, one quarter, one eighth and one sixteenth, separating the initial state from four updates. Declare equality acceptable and identify the first qualifying entry rather than merely the final recorded entry.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ReproZip：依賴閉包與可重現封裝缺口
related.titleEn: ReproZip: dependency closure and reproducible-package gaps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：輸出與排程皆合格才接受時間改善。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Accept timing improvement only when artifacts and schedule both satisfy their contracts.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「ReproZip：依賴閉包與可重現封裝缺口」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付required、observed、packaged三份manifest及差集；標明ReproZip trace需Linux，這個離線紙面實驗本身可跨平台重作。
related.differenceEn: Investigate ReproZip: dependency closure and reproducible-package gaps using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver separate required, observed and packaged manifests with their differences. Distinguish the Linux tracing requirement of ReproZip from this portable offline manifest exercise, and retain a record of deliberate exclusions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 時間零啟動 A、B；四秒啟動 C，六秒啟動 D，十一秒啟動 E，逐段計槽數。
為27個已封裝檔建立ID、路徑、大小、hash四欄；加入一個同名不同hash與一個不同路徑同內容別名，分別檢查錯誤接受與重複計數。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Start A and B at zero, C at four, D at six and E at eleven. Check slot occupancy across each interval and identify B-D-E as the limiting dependency chain.

Create ID, path, size and hash columns for the twenty-seven packaged matches. Add a same-name hash mismatch and a different-path alias of identical content to challenge both false acceptance and accidental double counting.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
